packageRules.description: Freeze @bcgov-nr/nr-theme at 1.8.9 — 1.9.x changes global font rendering (BCSans). Do not auto-update.
Hold typescript below v7 — the v7 native (Go) compiler ships no JS API, which typescript-eslint requires (peer range <6.1.0). Revisit once typescript-eslint supports TS 7.
